messages:
elaine: Quick check — crypto-service KMS + HSM integration timeline and owners for SOC2 fieldwork. We have a few outstanding items: attestation docs from vendor, audit-log ingestion proof, and integration test owners. Can owners please ack and list blockers? Thanks.
vikram: Ack. I can own audit-log ingestion proof. I need clarity on the expected retention window and sample queries the auditors want. @elaine any doc link?
elaine: Thanks @vikram. Retention window asked is 180 days per scope. See the compliance checklist: https://confluence.internal/redwood/compliance/kms-hsm-checklist (note: link is internal). Also auditors requested 3 sample queries for deletion/rotation events.
jon: I have a PR for the audit-log forwarder but it's blocked on schema changes in logs proto (see PR #428). Waiting review from @tasha. Small change.
tasha: Reviewing now, should be done today. Two notes: (1) need a unit test that simulates HSM rotation event format; (2) CI flake on the integration test — I'm investigating. I'll ping when green.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline failed in stage 'integration-tests' — logs: `timeout waiting for hsm-mock` — https://ci.internal/builds/9823
sam: Re: vendor attestation — reached out to AcmeHSM yesterday. They said next cert batch ships end of week. I can share the email thread privately.
vikram: For the sample queries, I can prepare an explainable set: rotation events (ROTATE_KEY), key revoke, and access-grant logs filtered by principal. Will post example SQL and time ranges.
elaine: Great. Owners summary: audit-log ingestion -> @vikram; forwarder PR -> @jon/@tasha (review); vendor attestation -> @sam. Blockers: vendor cert ETA, logs proto schema, and flaky CI. Next checkpoint Friday 10am PT. If anyone can't make it, please drop updates here before then. :calendar:
jon: Quick technical note — to validate ingestion locally run:
```
docker-compose -f docker-compose.hsm.yml up --build
python tools/send_test_event.py --type ROTATE_KEY --count 3
```
This produces sample events under /tmp/audit-samples.
tasha: I'll add the unit test and try a rebuild. If CI keeps failing, we might run the integration tests on a dedicated runner with hsm-mock pinned.
sam: I'll share attestation ETA and push vendor contact into the private thread. If they can accelerate, we'll update the evidence packet.
elaine: Thanks team. If any team needs a POA for the auditors (who to contact live), mention here and I'll add to the doc. Closing loop — see you Fri or update async. :eyes:
